levels.1: Protect the configuration that your completion run uses.

areas.name: Collection and Hidden-System Archive
areas.location_cue: The Collection and Config tiles on the main menu, plus Custom before a Free Dance chart.
areas.note: Finish every stable archive viewer, playback option, sound set, and documented hidden input.

levels.1: The reference archive fills from both Story and Free Dance.
levels.2: Finish Story Mode and clear every built-in Free Dance track, then open Collection > Database.
levels.3: After the Story and 27-track base clears are recorded, enter Collection > Database and open every newly available entry once so the archive finalizes.

levels.1: Unlocked songs feed a separate listening registry.
levels.2: Open Collection > Sound after completing the built-in track list.
levels.3: Enter Collection > Sound, scroll through every unlocked track, and start each entry once. Save one playlist so the music-player function is also documented.

levels.1: Story progress fills the illustration and movie viewer.
levels.2: After the complete Story archive, inspect Collection > Graphics.
levels.3: Open every available illustration and movie category in Collection > Graphics, including entries added by the Special chapter, until no unseen marker remains.

levels.1: The wardrobe archive has a separate model-viewing use.
levels.2: Open Collection > Character after completing the base costume and accessory registries.
levels.3: Load every dancer in Collection > Character, rotate the model, equip at least one alternate costume and accessory, and sample each available voice group.

levels.1: Each chart difficulty keeps an independent result.
levels.2: Use Collection > Score to confirm that every built-in track has four clear records.
levels.3: In Collection > Score, audit Easy, Normal, Hard, and All Night for every built-in track. Replace blank or failed results with clears and retain one saved replay.

levels.1: One recorded performance completes a separate viewer function.
levels.2: Choose a populated result inside Collection > Score and open its replay.
levels.3: Clear any Free Dance chart, enter Collection > Score, select that exact track and difficulty, choose Replay, and let playback begin before exiting.

levels.1: A cleared chart gains an automated appreciation option.
levels.2: Open Custom on a track-and-difficulty combination that already has a clear.
levels.3: Select Perfect Play from Custom for a previously cleared chart. Run one demonstration, then repeat only when reviewing choreography; each uncleared difficulty must first receive a normal clear.

levels.1: The updated Custom menu contains another presentation mode.
levels.2: Inspect the Custom options before a Free Dance chart.
levels.3: Choose Choreography Mode from the Free Dance Custom menu, start one supported track, and confirm the alternate camera presentation loads.

levels.1: The scratch-sound list expands after the complete base song clear.
levels.2: Clear all built-in Free Dance tracks, including the hidden Velvet Room track, then revisit Config.
levels.3: After all 27 built-in tracks have clear marks, open Config's scratch-sound option and cycle through the eleven newly added character-voice effects in addition to the six defaults.

levels.1: Perfect Play accepts a concealed pause-menu command.
levels.2: Pause a Perfect Play demonstration and prepare the directional and shoulder-button sequence.
levels.3: During Perfect Play, pause and enter Up, Up, Down, Down, L, R, L, R. Finish with Square+Triangle for blue, Square+Square for green, Triangle+Square for grey, or Triangle+Triangle for yellow; verify all four backgrounds.
